title: W05a: coherent ledger snapshot
description: Implement the versioned snapshot contract of plan 10.2 under the read-only lock: selected ledger root and label, schema version, snapshot time and content revision; complete task summaries with all seven statuses, priority, scope, dependency IDs, readiness and blockers, and evidence summaries; active claims with task, actor, worktree and branch; counts for tasks, issues, messages and handoffs; bounded issue, handoff and recent-message summaries with totals and explicit completeness metadata; and commit subjects with provenance and history summaries but no large bodies. Reuse the existing readiness helpers and never silently promote a todo task to ready. Counts cover the whole selected project rather than visible rows. The content hash is deterministic over the relevant canonical read set and excludes generated timestamps, lock artifacts, index files, reports and display selection. An unchanged supplied revision returns an explicit unchanged result with a fresh observation time, never an empty task list. A complete summary above the configured size limit returns a size diagnostic and is never marked complete.
acceptance: A snapshot of a fixture ledger matches its full contents, including readiness and blockers derived by the existing helpers rather than recomputed.
The content revision is stable for an unchanged ledger and changes for a content change, while generated artifacts and display state never affect it.
Supplying an unchanged revision returns the explicit unchanged result, and a response is never mistakable for an empty project.
A missing, inaccessible or invalid ledger and a pending intent are errors rather than successful empty collections, and an oversized complete summary is reported as a diagnostic.
Loading performs no recovery, cleanup or sync and writes nothing.
notes: Acceptance group A10. Reuse existing read helpers; do not create a parallel message-loading or readiness implementation.
